The double perovskites Rb2BiAuX6 (X = Cl, Br and I) possesses favorable nature. It exhibits band gap ranging 0.61 eV–1.8 eV. Rb2BiAuCl6 exhibits superior thermoelectric performance (ZT = 0.78 at 300 K).
